children: Treasury yields are once again center stage after comments by Fed officials and the release of higher-than-expected inflation data triggered selling in U.S. markets. Expectations of Fed hikes remain solidly priced in. Still, with the oil price in sharp retreat, there's some potential for a circuit break in coming weeks. Jack Chambers, interest rate strategist at CBA, is watching both factors closely, but still thinks there's scope for bond yields to rise even further. Economic momentum and increased expectations of Fed hikes will dominate, biasing 10-year yields higher in the near term, he says. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
